raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Enable `_can_enable_t1_fused_qk_norm_rope` for SM 120

On DGX Spark, with the DiT resident, the fused path makes Edge and Nano image requests 3.8-14.5% faster, and the output stays bit-identical. I have checked the #34347, and it has already made this kernel round the same way as the split path on SM120.

## Modifications

Add an `is_sm120` branch to the gate. Each condition comes from a measurement on Spark. The TP2 and SP2 numbers come from a test build that opened the gate for those topologies (it's a summary for the test results below):

- Edge `(relu2, 2048)` and Nano `(silu, 4096)`: Every Edge and Nano T=1 input I ran with the DiT resident is faster and bit-identical: Edge -9.0% to -14.5%, Nano -3.8% to -8.3%.
- `tp_size == 1`: On two DGX Sparks, TP2 gave no consistent gain. Nano was 0.9-2.2% slower. On Edge, identical requests return different images run to run even on main.
- `sp_size == 1`:  Under SP the fused kernel never runs at T=1, because the forward also requires sp 1. Opening the gate there only changes the RoPE cache dtype, and SP2 got 3-15% slower.
- Super and other shapes stay out: Super was not measured with the fused path. On Hopper, the dense Super shape got slower with it.

CFG parallel runs each rank at tp 1 and sp 1, so it is admitted. It measured 4-10% faster.

For test cases:
- Gate unit tests cover the admitted shapes and the excluded shapes and topologies. The test class now derives from `CustomTestCase`.
- The split-vs-fused parity test in `test_cosmos3_edge_fusions.py` now also runs on capability 12, for both the Edge (16 query heads) and Nano (32 query heads) layouts. It is also registered on `1-gpu-small` (RTX 5090), so CI will check SM120 numerics when that job runs.

**Note:** SM10x and Hopper are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

- Every measured configuration this PR admits gives bit-identical images on main and on this PR (SSIM 1, PSNR inf). This covers:
  - the `cosmos3-edge-t2i` and `cosmos3-nano-t2i` presets at exact, lossless and high quality;
  - `sglang serve` requests;
  - 48 more input and placement combinations, plus a repeated offload run.
- Parity test: 10 passed on DGX Spark. I broke the fused call four ways (rounding off, non-neox RoPE, K/V prefixes swapped, K norm weight used for Q); each one fails all 6 parity cases.
- `test_cosmos3.py`: 145 passed (143 on main).

<details>
<summary>Input coverage</summary>

Extra base-BF16 cases, each run main, PR, PR, main on fresh servers:
- every supported size, plus off-template and padded sizes;
- long prompts and negatives, guidance 1.0, and batched CFG (B=2);
- the system prompt on;
- `/v1/videos` with 1 frame, 3 frames, and 1 frame plus an image;
- a Nano transfer request with a one-frame chunk.

Selected cases also ran under auto, manual and layerwise-offload placement, and with CFG parallel on two Sparks. A probe build, run on the new request types and on CFG parallel, confirmed that they run at T=1 through `fused_qknorm_rope_warp`.

Super control: TP2 on two DGX Sparks with layerwise offload stays on the split path, and its outputs are identical on main and on this PR.

</details>

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Saved-request wall time on Sparks, measured on the client from request start through response decoding. Saving the image comes after and is not included. Each arm starts a fresh `sglang serve` and sends 1 warmup and 3 measured requests. Arms run main, PR, PR, main.

| Model | main | This PR |
|-|-|-|
| Edge, 640x640, 35 steps, manual placement | 1.764 s | 1.556 s (-11.8%) |
| Nano, 1024x1024, 35 steps, auto placement (DiT resident) | 13.669 s | 12.679 s (-7.2%) |

- Other inputs with the DiT resident:
  - Edge, 20 inputs: -9.0% to -14.5%;
  - Nano, 18 inputs across 20 input and placement combinations: -3.8% to -8.3%.
- CFG parallel on two Sparks: Edge -10.1% / -8.0%, Nano -5.0% / -4.3%.
- With offload there is no consistent change:
  - Edge layerwise, 8 arms: 7.129 -> 7.136 s;
  - Nano layerwise: 64.37 -> 63.93 s;
  - Edge auto (whole-DiT CPU offload): +3.1% / +0.5%, while arm means vary by up to 12%.
- Profile, 6 profiler steps:
  - Edge: kernel launches 11282 -> 3890, GPU kernel time 283.3 -> 261.2 ms;
  - Nano: kernel launches 14258 -> 4754, GPU kernel time 2473.2 -> 2279.8 ms.
- Note: SM120 is not measured. The parity test on the RTX 5090 runner will check numerics there when it runs.

<details>
<summary>Preset worker latency (bench_diffusion_denoise.py)</summary>

The preset runs use `bench_diffusion_denoise.py`, one measured request after warmup, compared with `compare_perf.py`. "E2E" is the worker's `total_duration_ms`, recorded before the output is saved. ABBA rows run main, PR, PR, main. The Edge exact and high rows come from the quality/BCG matrix, which runs all main cells first.

| Preset | Quality | E2E, main -> PR | Denoise, main -> PR |
|-|-|-|-|
| `cosmos3-edge-t2i` | lossless (ABBA) | 1816.8 -> 1605.2 ms (-11.6%) | 1629.9 -> 1415.2 ms (-13.2%) |
| `cosmos3-edge-t2i` | exact | 1822.1 -> 1598.5 ms (-12.3%) | 1593.2 -> 1368.2 ms (-14.1%) |
| `cosmos3-edge-t2i` | high | 1764.0 -> 1573.6 ms (-10.8%) | 1574.5 -> 1387.3 ms (-11.9%) |
| `cosmos3-nano-t2i` | lossless (ABBA) | 14390.4 -> 13416.9 ms (-6.8%) | 13960.0 -> 12983.8 ms (-7.0%) |
| `cosmos3-nano-t2i` | exact (ABBA) | 13621.9 -> 12818.8 ms (-5.9%) | 13066.1 -> 12264.3 ms (-6.1%) |
| `cosmos3-nano-t2i` | high (ABBA) | 13474.2 -> 12561.0 ms (-6.8%) | 13040.4 -> 12129.5 ms (-7.0%) |

BCG is not evaluated. The preset's BCG cells capture no graph for Cosmos3, so those runs fall back to eager.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

- Two DGX Sparks, BF16, Cosmos 3 Edge Nano and Super.
- Presets: `bench_diffusion_denoise.py --model cosmos3-edge-t2i|cosmos3-nano-t2i`; serve: `sglang serve --model-path <model>`.
- Two Sparks runs use `--num-gpus 2 --nnodes 2 --performance-mode manual`.

</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

     *,

+    is_sm120: bool,
     hidden_act: str,
     tp_size: int,
     sp_size: int,
@@ -89,6 +90,11 @@ def _can_enable_t1_fused_qk_norm_rope(
         return False
     if is_blackwell:
         return True
+    if is_sm120:
+        shape = (hidden_act, hidden_size)
+        return (
+            tp_size == 1 and sp_size == 1 and shape in (("relu2", 2048), ("silu", 4096))
+        )
     if not is_hopper or sp_size != 1:
         return False
     if tp_size == 1:
@@ -1777,6 +1783,7 @@ def forward(
         enable_t1_fused_qk_norm_rope = T == 1 and _can_enable_t1_fused_qk_norm_rope(
             is_blackwell=current_platform.is_blackwell(),
             is_hopper=current_platform.is_hopper(),
+            is_sm120=current_platform.is_sm120(),
             hidden_act=self.hidden_act,
             hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
             tp_size=get_tp_world_size(),

@@ -108,12 +108,13 @@ def _cosmos3_server_args(config=None, batching_max_size=1):
     )
 
 
-class TestCosmos3T1FusedQKNormRoPE(unittest.TestCase):
+class TestCosmos3T1FusedQKNormRoPE(CustomTestCase):
     def _can_enable(
         self,
         *,
         is_blackwell=False,
         is_hopper=False,
+        is_sm120=False,
         hidden_act="silu",
         tp_size=1,
         sp_size=1,
@@ -123,6 +124,7 @@ def _can_enable(
         return _can_enable_t1_fused_qk_norm_rope(
             is_blackwell=is_blackwell,
             is_hopper=is_hopper,
+            is_sm120=is_sm120,
             hidden_act=hidden_act,
             tp_size=tp_size,
             sp_size=sp_size,
@@ -195,6 +197,24 @@ def test_hopper_sequence_parallel_disabled(self):
     def test_compiled_path_disabled(self):
         self.assertFalse(self._can_enable(is_hopper=True, is_compiled=True))
 
+    def test_sm120_single_gpu_nano_and_edge_enabled(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._can_enable(is_sm120=True, hidden_size=4096))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            self._can_enable(is_sm120=True, hidden_act="relu2", hidden_size=2048)
+        )
+
+    def test_sm120_unmeasured_shapes_and_topologies_disabled(self):
+        for overrides in (
+            {"hidden_size": 5120},
+            {"hidden_size": 5120, "tp_size": 2},
+            {"hidden_act": "relu2", "hidden_size": 4096},
+            {"hidden_size": 4096, "tp_size": 2},
+            {"hidden_size": 4096, "sp_size": 2},
+            {"hidden_size": 4096, "is_compiled": True},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(overrides=overrides):
+                self.assertFalse(self._can_enable(is_sm120=True, **overrides))
+
     def test_other_architecture_disabled(self):
         self.assertFalse(self._can_enable())

+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] not in (9, 12):
+        pytest.skip("Split-path exact parity covers the Hopper and SM12x paths")
     torch.manual_seed(42)
-    qkv = torch.randn(batch, tokens, 32, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
-    q, k, v = qkv[:, :, :16], qkv[:, :, 16:24], qkv[:, :, 24:]

+    q, k, v = (

     v_und = torch.randn_like(k_und)
     before = qkv.clone(), k_und.clone(), v_und.clone()
